imperial.name: Imperial Rome
imperial.desc: At the heart of an empire, marble temples and grand civic spaces frame a city built for spectacle.
changes: A monumental Forum at the civic heart
The Colosseum hosts public spectacles
Palatine palaces overlook the valley
imperial.fact: The Colosseum is complete: four exterior stories surround a working arena and continuous seating.

medieval.name: Medieval Rome
medieval.desc: The imperial city becomes a patchwork of homes, churches and gardens among ancient stone.
changes: Narrow houses and towers replace courtyard blocks
Winding paths cross gardens and pasture
Ancient monuments find new uses
medieval.fact: Missing exterior bays expose small dwellings inside the Colosseum; the Forum becomes pasture.

baroque.name: Baroque Rome
baroque.desc: Church facades, palaces and fountains add a new layer of grandeur around the ancient city.
changes: Domed churches and broad palazzi shape the skyline
A fountain anchors the formal piazza
Terraced gardens occupy the Palatine
baroque.fact: The Colosseum remains a depleted ruin; higher ground partly buries the Forum’s surviving columns.

modern.name: Modern Rome
modern.desc: A living city surrounds an open-air archive. Ancient landmarks endure beside the rhythms of modern life.
changes: The Forum is exposed as an archaeological site
Buses, crossings and shops line modern streets
Balconies and roof terraces shape urban blocks
modern.fact: Conservation buttresses and visitor paths frame the Colosseum; excavated foundations define the Forum.

late-antique.name: An ancient city changes
late-antique.desc: Civic buildings age and lose their upper structures. Reuse and smaller settlements gradually reshape the imperial landscape.
changes: Selected roofs and wall sections are lost
Ancient masonry remains in place
New uses develop around surviving monuments
late-antique.fact: The Colosseum’s northern core and inner arcades remain anchored while individual southern bays deteriorate.

medieval-settlement.name: Medieval settlement
medieval-settlement.desc: Homes, churches and towers grow among enduring ancient structures. Occupied sites and fragments coexist.
changes: Narrow houses and towers replace courtyard blocks
Winding paths cross gardens and pasture
Ancient monuments find new uses
medieval-settlement.fact: The Forum’s rising ground surrounds surviving columns; dwellings occupy parts of the damaged amphitheater.

renaissance.name: Renaissance to Baroque
renaissance.desc: Palaces, domes and facades are added at different times, while older buildings remain or find new uses.
changes: Domed churches and broad palazzi shape the skyline
A fountain anchors the formal piazza
Terraced gardens occupy the Palatine
renaissance.fact: The Colosseum remains a depleted ruin; higher ground partly buries the Forum’s surviving columns.

archaeology.name: Archaeology & modernization
archaeology.desc: Excavation reveals buried foundations while roads, shops and conservation works gradually change the surrounding city.
changes: The Forum is exposed as an archaeological site
Buses, crossings and shops line modern streets
Balconies and roof terraces shape urban blocks
archaeology.fact: Conservation buttresses and visitor paths frame the Colosseum; excavated foundations define the Forum.

living-capital.name: A living historic capital
living-capital.desc: Excavation reveals buried foundations while roads, shops and conservation works gradually change the surrounding city.
changes: The Forum is exposed as an archaeological site
Buses, crossings and shops line modern streets
Balconies and roof terraces shape urban blocks
living-capital.fact: Conservation buttresses and visitor paths frame the Colosseum; excavated foundations define the Forum.

imperial.name: 帝国时期的罗马
imperial.desc: 大理石神庙、宏伟的公共空间与壮观的斗兽场，共同构成帝国中心的城市图景。
changes: 古典广场成为城市公共生活的中心
完整的斗兽场承载公共观演活动
帕拉蒂尼山上的宫殿俯瞰山谷
imperial.fact: 斗兽场的外立面、竞技场和分层看台完整相连。

medieval.name: 中世纪罗马
medieval.desc: 古代城市逐渐成为住宅、教堂与花园交织的聚落，新的生活延续在古老石墙之间。
changes: 狭窄住宅与塔楼形成新的街区
曲折小路穿过菜园与牧地
古代建筑被赋予新的用途
medieval.fact: 缺失的外墙暴露内部结构，斗兽场内出现小型住宅，古罗马广场逐渐成为牧地。

baroque.name: 巴洛克罗马
baroque.desc: 教堂立面、宫邸与喷泉，在古代遗迹周围塑造出新的城市秩序与宏伟气质。
changes: 穹顶教堂与宫邸重塑城市轮廓
喷泉与正式广场成为公共空间中心
帕拉蒂尼山出现台地花园
baroque.fact: 斗兽场作为残缺的历史废墟继续存在；地面堆积使广场遗存的部分柱列被掩埋。

modern.name: 今日罗马
modern.desc: 现代城市围绕露天历史档案持续运转，古代遗迹与当代生活共同存在。
changes: 古罗马广场逐步成为开放的考古遗址
公交车、人行横道与商铺沿街展开
阳台与屋顶平台丰富城市街区
modern.fact: 保护性支撑与游客步道围绕斗兽场，发掘出的基础重新勾勒出古罗马广场的格局。

late-antique.name: 古代城市的转变
late-antique.desc: 公共建筑逐渐老化，上部结构局部损失。再利用与小型聚落缓慢改变帝国时期的城市景观。
changes: 部分屋顶与上部墙体逐渐缺失
古代石材与下部墙体保留在原地
新的生活围绕历史建筑展开
late-antique.fact: 斗兽场北侧主体持续保留，南侧不同墙段在各自的时间窗口中逐步损毁。

medieval-settlement.name: 中世纪聚落
medieval-settlement.desc: 住宅、教堂与塔楼在古代结构之间生长，仍在使用的空间与历史残片彼此交织。
changes: 狭窄住宅与塔楼形成新的街区
曲折小路穿过菜园与牧地
古代建筑被赋予新的用途
medieval-settlement.fact: 广场地面逐渐抬高，古代柱列仍然保留；损毁的斗兽场内部出现再利用住宅。

renaissance.name: 文艺复兴至巴洛克
renaissance.desc: 宫邸、穹顶和装饰立面在不同时期逐步加入，旧建筑继续存在，或被赋予新的用途。
changes: 穹顶教堂与宫邸重塑城市轮廓
喷泉与正式广场成为公共空间中心
帕拉蒂尼山出现台地花园
renaissance.fact: 斗兽场作为残缺的历史废墟继续存在；地面堆积使广场遗存的部分柱列被掩埋。

archaeology.name: 考古与现代化
archaeology.desc: 考古发掘重新揭示被掩埋的基础，道路、商铺与保护工程逐渐改变周边环境。
changes: 考古发掘揭示古代建筑基础
现代道路与公共设施逐步出现
历史建筑保留并接受局部翻修
archaeology.fact: 保护性支撑与游客步道围绕斗兽场，发掘出的基础重新勾勒出古罗马广场的格局。

living-capital.name: 延续至今的历史城市
living-capital.desc: 考古遗址与当代交通、商业和公共生活共同存在，古代遗迹成为现代城市的一部分。
changes: 古罗马广场逐步成为开放的考古遗址
公交车、人行横道与商铺沿街展开
阳台与屋顶平台丰富城市街区
living-capital.fact: 保护性支撑与游客步道围绕斗兽场，发掘出的基础重新勾勒出古罗马广场的格局。
